{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Tumor imaging only at screening, no on-treatment assessments",
      "quote": "Tumor imaging (including brain imaging) | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "Tumor imaging is only performed at screening, with no on-treatment tumor assessments scheduled. This is insufficient for evaluating endpoints like progression-free survival and objective response rate, which require serial imaging.",
      "fix": "Add tumor imaging at regular intervals (e.g., every 6-8 weeks) during treatment and at end of treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Coagulation tests only at screening and EOT, not during treatment",
      "quote": "Coagulation: PT, INR, and aPTT | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Coagulation parameters are only measured at screening and end of treatment, but not during the treatment cycles. This may miss important safety signals, especially if patients are on anticoagulants or have liver dysfunction.",
      "fix": "Include coagulation tests at least once per cycle or as clinically indicated."
    },
    {
      "title": "Urinalysis only at screening, Cycle 1, and EOT",
      "quote": "Urinalysis | X | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Urinalysis is only performed at screening, Cycle 1, and EOT, but not during later cycles. This may miss renal toxicity that could develop during treatment.",
      "fix": "Add urinalysis at regular intervals (e.g., every cycle or every other cycle)."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECOG Performance Status assessed at every visit, but no analysis method",
      "quote": "ECOG Performance Status | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ECOG is assessed at every visit, but the statistics section lacks an analysis method for this endpoint, as noted in the rule findings. This inconsistency may lead to analysis issues.",
      "fix": "Add a statistical analysis method for ECOG Performance Status in the statistics section."
    },
    {
      "title": "12-Lead ECG not performed at every cycle, potential missed cardiotoxicity",
      "quote": "12-Lead ECG | X | X |  |  |  | X |  | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "ECGs are not performed at every cycle (missing Cycles 2, 3, 4, 6, and 7-17). This could miss cardiac adverse events, especially if the drug has QT prolongation risk.",
      "fix": "Consider performing ECG at least every cycle or as clinically indicated."
    },
    {
      "title": "Screening window of 28 days may be too long for lab values",
      "quote": "Screening Days -28 to -1 (Day -28)",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "A 28-day screening window for laboratory tests (e.g., hematology, chemistry) may be too long, as values can change significantly in that time, potentially leading to ineligible patients or baseline inaccuracies.",
      "fix": "Shorten the screening window for lab assessments to 14 days or repeat labs if screening exceeds 14 days."
    },
    {
      "title": "Pregnancy test at every visit, but not at EOT or follow-up",
      "quote": "Serum or urine pregnancy test | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Pregnancy tests are performed at every treatment visit but not at the discontinuation visit or safety follow-up. This could miss pregnancies that occur after the last dose.",
      "fix": "Add pregnancy test at EOT and safety follow-up visits."
    },
    {
      "title": "Adverse events collected at every visit, but no analysis method",
      "quote": "Adverse events | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Adverse events are collected at every visit, but the statistics section lacks an analysis method for this endpoint, as noted in the rule findings. This inconsistency may lead to analysis issues.",
      "fix": "Add a statistical analysis method for adverse events in the statistics section."
    }
  ]
}
